narr: Scattered showers and thunderstorms developed across southern Utah on the afternoon of July 1. A strong thunderstorm moved over sensitive drainages in Capitol Reef National Park and caused isolated flash flooding.
ev: Capitol Reef National Park rangers report 4 to 5 inches of water flowing across Scenic Drive at the first wash crossing. Water 6 to 7 inches deep was reported at the State Route 24 bridge crossing the Grand Wash. Waterfalls were also observed in the park, and debris was flowing down the Fremont River.
